start_date.description: The start date. Uses the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss. An example date: 1955-11-05T22:04:00.

end_date.description: The end date. Uses the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss. An example date: 1955-11-05T22:04:00.

copy_tasks.description: Indicates whether when selected, tasks in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_invitations.description: Indicates whether when selected, invitations in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_invitees.description: Indicates whether when selected, invitees in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_designations.description: Indicates whether when selected, designations in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_expenses.description: Indicates whether when selected, expenses in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_prices.description: Indicates whether when selected, registration options in the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_attributes.description: Indicates whether when selected, attributes in the source event will be copied to the new event..

attribute_defined.description: Indicates whether determines if event attributes are defined inorder to display copyattributes..

site_required.description: Indicates whether site required. Read-only in the SOAP API.

copy_preferences.description: Indicates whether when selected, event preference groups in the source event will be copied to the new event..

event_category.description: The category. This code table can be queried at https://api.sky.blackbaud.com/alt-adnmg/codetables/eventcategorycode/entries

copy_team_structure.description: Indicates whether when selected, teams in the appeal linked to the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_team_fundraisers.description: Indicates whether when selected, team members in the appeal linked to the source event will be copied to the new event..

copy_lodging_options.description: Indicates whether when selected, event lodging options in the source event will be copied to the new event..

add_quick_compare.description: Indicates whether when selected, make the original event the quick compare event of the copy..

event_location_room.description: The room/unit. This simple list can be queried at https://api.sky.blackbaud.com/alt-adnmg/simplelists/5f5a58fe-1594-4004-b0fd-7eb92fb7cf52?parameters=event_location_id,{event_location_id}.

copy_job_occurrences.description: Indicates whether when selected, job occurrences in the source event will be copied to the new event..

auction.description: Indicates whether flag used to add extra metadata if the event is an auction..

hide_from_calendar.description: Indicates whether determines whether or not to hide this event from the events calendar..

designations_on_fees.description: Indicates whether determines whether or not event allows designations on fees..

copy_public_description.description: Indicates whether when selected, the web forms description on source event will be copied to the new event..
